## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**2. Which sectors are leading?**

Communication strength driven by NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -14.06% | 1M: -17.29%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -14.37% | 1M: -9.15%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.49% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -11.25% | 1M: -13.25%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -5.66%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in staples, discretionary and select industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +11.90%) ABOVE TREND; note multiple RECOVERY names (PLTR, PANW, BKNG, AMZN) — this is a major divergence that tempers conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed: Tech 1W: +1.77% | 1M: -2.16%; INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND and ADBE (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +3.61%) ABOVE TREND offset LRCX (1W: -10.09% | 1M: -6.59%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +1.66%) CORRECTION.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Weak and broad: Financials 1W: -3.86% | 1M: -5.07%; GS (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND and JPM (1W: -4.11% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND highlight sector stress despite isolated bullish headlines.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed defensives but not leading: Healthcare 1W: -1.69% | 1M: +1.24%; UNH (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +1.62%) ABOVE TREND while LLY (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -1.85%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -1.58% | 1M: +3.35%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to clear 1W/1M leaders (INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +13.32%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to structurally weak laggards (EL, LRCX, GS) while monitoring recovery candidates for confirmation; style mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +13.32%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: LRCX (1W: -10.09% | 1M: -6.59%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -14.06% | 1M: -17.29%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.31% | 1M: +11.59%) and Communication (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +7.03%) for follow-through. BEARISH: Financials (1W: -3.86% | 1M: -5.07%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -1.58%) for continued pressure.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +1.66%) CORRECTION — hold/break of the recent 1W price range will signal next directional tilt; monitor AAPL (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -3.32%) BELOW TREND for stabilization or further downside; XOM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.59%) ABOVE TREND holding 1M support would confirm sector strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NFLX (+55): Netflix walks away from Warner Bros. deal; price confirming — NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND. PSX (+55): analyst upgrade/dividend chatter; price confirming — PSX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +13.32%) ABOVE TREND. AVGO (+80): strong AI revenue narrative — monitor price action for confirmation (price timeframe not in provided subset).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LRCX (-55): fab cost/geopolitics headline and price confirming weakness — LRCX (1W: -10.09% | 1M: -6.59%) BELOW TREND. PM (-55): earnings miss and price confirming — PM (1W: -9.49% | 1M: -4.12%) BELOW TREND. NVDA (-50): headlines on H200 production pause create divergence vs price — NVDA (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +1.66%) CORRECTION, watch for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow sector participation and headline-driven moves. INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND and PSX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +13.32%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: breadth remains weak (3/11) and major 1W/1M divergences (LRCX, NVDA, PLTR, GS) warrant monitoring before expanding risk.
